blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Police have placed a 15-year-old student under the care of a youth facility on Tuesday after he was linked to an alleged online threat against a school in neighboring General Santos City. In a statement, Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office 12 (PRO-12) director, said the minor was allegedly behind a Facebook account that sent messages threatening violence against students, teachers, school personnel, and security guards. The messages also reportedly contained demands involving three students, prompting concern within the school community.
